title: A Love Letter And A Wake-up Call To The Cannabis Industry

content_html_sanitized:
Generally, I try to keep MarijuanaNews “on topic ” and my other personal political beliefs out of it. However, I make no secret that I call myself a “libertarian” and I grew up in the business world.

 

So, brothers and sisters, to borrow from Music Man, We got trouble And to borrow from StarWars, The Empire Strikes Back.

 

And yes, this is also show business, so get ready to get onstage, because the lights are going on and the curtain is going up, ready or not.

 

A year ago, Donald Trump voted for the legalization of recreational cannabis on the Florida ballot, because he knew that it was popular in Florida, and it did get 55% of the votes.

 

However, because the system is rigged against the people, it required 60% to become the state law. He got slightly more votes, and became President. Now he has staffed his Administration with rabid Prohibitionists.

 

And they have blocked the rescheduling of cannabis from Schedule 1, saying that it has no medical value, which is contrary to his stated beliefs.

See

Former NFL Star, Ricky Williams, Has Been Fighting For Medical Marijuana For Over Twenty Years. Meets With Trump Officials At White House.

And

The Complicated Politics of Trump’s Medical Cannabis Policies

 

More ominously, the Administration and the Republican Congressional Leadership allowed the attachment of a bill repealing the hemp bill effectively killing a multibillion dollar industry and reasserting Federal control over what should be under state laws. Beyond the substance of the law, the way that it was passed without substantive debate raises serious concerns about the democratic process.

See

What The Hemp Ban Reveals About The Condition of Our Democracy

 

So we really do “got trouble, right here in River City!”

 

Of course, everyone always “needs to do a better job”. Saying that is really just saying nothing. We need to change the way we think about business, and our relationship with our customers and the way we communicate with the world. It’s do or die time, folks.

 

First, we are not just about cannabis. We have to be about Freedom!

 

There would not even be a cannabis industry, if it were not for Dennis Peron or Jack Herer, or all of the activists whose names we never knew.

See

All California Cannabis Clubs Face Closing -- "We’re Going To Stay Here Until The Tanks Come" Vows Peron

 

Many of them died in pain that cannabis could have ameliorated. Some were even driven to suicide in the name of “justice.” Never forget!

See

Lest We Forget: From Twenty Years Ago, July 12,2005:The Murder of Steve McWilliams. An Indictment, Not An Obituary. The Absurdity of Evil. Condolences from NORML.

 

Second, our packaging has to be about more than selling our products. It needs to be about selling Freedom. Obviously, it has to be “childproof”, but it also needs to be Prohibitionist-proof. The Hemp industry left itself vulnerable to exactly what happened to it.

 

Over the decades that I have been observing “Marijuana Prohibition” in action I have been — and still am — astounded by the failure of the democratic process, as we just witnessed in the stealth banning of hemp products, but also the failure of the “public discourse” in the most public arenas.

See

How Politicized Psychiatry and Bad Journalism Combined to Make It Easy for Me. Two Articles for the Price of One

And

Marijuana Abuse By Youth Linked to Bad Journalism

 

Roughly 90% of the American people are in favor of “medical marijuana”, but, as noted, it is still classified as Schedule 1, while Fentanyl is in Schedule 2, and Xanax is Schedule 3.

See

Marijuana Is In Schedule One. Fentanyl Is In Schedule 2. Think About It.

 

And medical cannabis is still illegal in 10 states.

See Marijuana Legality by State 2025 | Where Is Weed Legal?

 

In several states, state officials have gone to extraordinary lengths to prevent the voters from implementing even medical marijuana laws that have been passed by a substantial majority of the voters.

 

America’s founders feared that a majoritarian democracy could restrict individual freedoms, but they would be astonished that a small clique in “law enforcement” would be able to block the public support for hemp, a crop that many of them grew.

See

On The Fourth of July It Is Good To Be Reminded That The Only Doctor Who Signed The Declaration of Independence Warned Us

 

The freedom that we are demanding is not just for us and our businesses, or even our customers, it has to be for the American people and the people of all the other countries, where the people actually need cannabis more than we do.

 

We must demand that the editocracy, the politicians and law enforcement who refuse to take cannabis seriously pay attention to the facts and to the law and to the people, and take us seriously.

Some are.

See

MMJ International Continues Its Crusade Against DEA Corruption and Incompetence

 

I know from my own experience in business that “business people” don’t like politics, but the prey have no choice but to know about predation. Otherwise, we are not just on the menu. We are the main course.

From 2025, see

Why People Who Hate Cannabis And/Or Think It Is Dangerous Should Be Opposed To Prohibition
